name: Luna Hernandez
source:
Daughter of Mr. Hernandez

Works a part-time job at her dad's café.

Luna is a mysterious lady who hides much more than what she shows.
She's a girl of few words, dresses in black, and she never takes her gloves off.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/eternum-sneak-5-53996759]Patreon[/url]]
